title: The Long Signal
author: Lior Oyelaran
blurb: Ulyana Lockridge, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
